name: vtc-event
description: A community event's own identity (vtc/events/create with identity, VTI-EVT-140 – 145). The community's VTA mints and holds it; the community never does. The event's DID signs its tickets and attendance records, and nothing else, under an authorization credential the community issues it, so a verifier chains ticket → event → community. A series has one identity for every occurrence. The document carries a signing key (assertion and authentication) and a key-agreement key, and nothing else: no service, because the community serves no transport at the event's DID (VTI-EVT-143, VTI-KEY-050), and no title, description, place or label, so resolving the DID reveals nothing about the event or its registrants. did:webvh rather than did:peer, so its keys can rotate. WITNESSES is recommended where the DID host is not fully trusted.
